newsitem.title: UK: Bass deal may be sent to merger body-report.
newsitem.headline: Bass deal may be sent to merger body-report.

text.p: The Department of Trade and Industry is likely to refer Bass Plc's proposed purchase of Carlsberg-Tetley to the Monopolies and Mergers Commission, the Times newspaper said on Monday.

The Office of Fair Trading is believed to have ruled against the 205 million stg deal, which would create Britain's biggest brewer with a market share of 40 percent, the Times said. The office sent its advice to Trade and Industry minister Ian Lang last week and it is thought to have strongly advised that the purchase be referred to the commission, the Times said.
A department spokesman on Friday was unable to say how long a decision on the deal would take as there are two parts to the proposed merger.

In one part, Bass would take 50 percent of Carlsberg-Tetley, which is subject to a statutory deadline of December 25. The other is a full takeover of Carlsberg-Tetley, including the acquisition of Carlsberg Tetley A/S, which has no statutory deadline.
"We would expect both parts of the merger to be looked at together and an announcement about both will be made at the same time," a department spokesman told Reuters on Friday.
